description: Create a registration order (a price-locked quote). Returns quote{price_usd, locked_until}, payment requirements (exact amount, address, x402 accepts) and checkout_url: a prefilled /order/{id} page a human can pay from. Policy: check availability right before buying, show the quote to the human and get confirmation before paying; pass idempotency_key (retries with the same key never create a second order; if omitted, identical calls within 15 min are de-duplicated). pay_with=balance pays instantly from prepaid balance. pay_with=card returns status needs_human (code SCA_REQUIRED) with a single-use Stripe checkout link (card_pay_url): give it to a person, who opens it and completes card payment (card fee added; the card issuer may ask the person to approve it). The agent cannot complete card payment itself; poll check_order until the person has paid.

chain.description: payment network (default base). hyperevm = HyperEVM (chain 999, USDC/USDT0), bsc = BNB Chain (56, 18-decimal USDC/USDT)

pay_with.description: crypto (default: USDC/USDT, x402 or transfer), balance (prepaid balance), or card: returns a single-use Stripe pay link that a person opens and pays; the agent does not pay by card itself

showcase.description: Opt in to the public /showcase listing (only if the user asked)
